payload.name: Tralendr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI is great at planning trips and terrible at keeping them usable. Tralendr is the home for AI-planned trips. Ask ChatGPT to plan a trip, then save it to your free Tralendr account, where it becomes a visual day-by-day itinerary with every place on a map, shareable with one link, and ready on your phone while you travel. Plan anywhere, keep it in Tralendr. Free forever.
payload.longDescription: AI 擅长规划旅行，却不擅长让行程保持实用。Tralendr 是 AI 旅行计划的管理空间。让 ChatGPT 规划旅行，然后保存到免费的 Tralendr 账户中，生成可视化的逐日行程：每个地点都显示在地图上，可通过一个链接分享，旅行时也能在手机上查看。随处规划，集中保存在 Tralendr。永久免费。

payload.name: Carhopp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Carhopp finds and compares rental cars at airports, train stations, and cities worldwide. Search live prices from major agencies and local suppliers, filter by category (economy, SUV, van, premium), transmission, price, and free cancellation, then check rental conditions and continue to the provider's secure booking page. Ask things like "rent a car in Barcelona next weekend" or "cheap automatic SUV at CDG airport".
payload.longDescription: Carhopp 可在全球范围内查找并比较机场、火车站和城市的租车服务。搜索主要租车公司和本地供应商的实时价格，按类别（经济型、SUV、厢式车、高端车型）、变速箱类型、价格和免费取消选项筛选，然后查看租车条件并前往服务商的安全预订页面。可以这样询问：“下周末在巴塞罗那租车”或“在戴高乐机场租一辆便宜的自动挡 SUV”。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

Opening hours tell you how a place usually is. OPEN tells you what is true at this moment, because the answer comes from the business owner, who updates it from their phone. A shop that closed early today says so. A place with no fresh information reads UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is never presented as CLOSED.

Ask in plain language - "what is open near Machane Yehuda right now?", "find a coffee shop that stays open at least another hour" - and the answer arrives with an interactive map inside the conversation. Service professionals are covered too: plumbers, electricians, handymen and locksmiths report whether they are available for work right now.

Four read-only tools: open_now, search_businesses, get_business and list_categories. No sign-in, no writes, no personal data, no advertising.

Coverage: OPEN is in pilot in Jerusalem, Israel, and the catalogue grows through in-person recruitment of business owners. A query about another city will return little or nothing. Hebrew and English.

payload.name: Rio Las Vegas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rio Las Vegas helps guests explore hotel details, room and suite options, images, rates, booking links, cancellation links, and service request confirmations directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Rio Las Vegas 可帮助住客直接在 ChatGPT 中查看酒店详情、客房和套房选项、图片、价格、预订链接、取消链接以及服务请求确认信息。

payload.name: Shqiponja eSIM
payload.description: 查找 eSIM 流量套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare current eSIM data packages for destinations worldwide. Search by country, data amount, validity period, or maximum price, then review package details directly in ChatGPT. Shqiponja eSIM provides read-only travel connectivity information and does not complete purchases or process payments inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 查找并比较全球各目的地当前可用的 eSIM 流量套餐。按国家、流量、有效期或最高价格搜索，然后直接在 ChatGPT 中查看套餐详情。Shqiponja eSIM 提供只读的旅行网络连接信息，不会在 ChatGPT 内完成购买或处理付款。

payload.name: The Grand Hotel Collection
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Grand Hotel Collection makes it easy to discover and book boutique stays in Oregon—right from your AI chat.

Browse rooms with rich photos, compare options side-by-side, and check real-time rates with an interactive calendar. Select your dates, explore amenities, and reserve your stay in just a few taps.

Featuring two distinctive properties: The Grand Hotel at Bridgeport (Tigard) and The Grand Hotel in Salem.
payload.longDescription:
The Grand Hotel Collection 让你可以直接通过 AI 聊天轻松发现并预订俄勒冈州的精品住宿。

浏览配有精美照片的客房，并排比较选项，通过交互式日历查看实时价格。选择日期、了解设施，只需轻点几下即可预订住宿。

包含两家特色酒店：位于 Tigard 的 The Grand Hotel at Bridgeport，以及位于 Salem 的 The Grand Hotel。

payload.name: Wanderu
payload.description: 搜索美国巴士和火车行程
payload.summaryOriginal: Search US bus and train trips
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare bus and train trips across the United States. Wanderu searches major carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, Amtrak, and more to find you the best routes and prices. See departure times, trip duration, and prices — then book directly on Wanderu.com.
payload.longDescription: 搜索并比较美国各地的巴士和火车行程。Wanderu 会检索 Greyhound、FlixBus、Amtrak 等主要运营商，帮你找到合适的路线和价格。查看出发时间、行程时长和票价，然后直接在 Wanderu.com 预订。

payload.name: NEBLES
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NEBLES Rental Assistant helps users search verified monthly condo rentals in Bangkok, compare rent and move-in costs, inspect room details, and understand the NEBLES booking process through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: NEBLES Rental Assistant 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索经核实的曼谷公寓月租房源、比较租金和入住费用、查看房间详情，并了解 NEBLES 的预订流程。

payload.name: Bellhopt Concierge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bellhopt helps vacation rental guests request concierge services for their stay.

Guests can browse available services, choose what they need, add stay details, enter the property address, and submit a request for Bellhopt to review. Depending on the location and available services, requests may include pre-arrival groceries, private chef experiences, transportation, spa and massage, arrival setup, celebration setup, and custom stay needs.

Bellhopt is designed for travelers who want a smoother, more prepared vacation rental experience. It gives guests one simple place to request stay services instead of searching for local options or coordinating everything manually.

Submitting a request does not confirm a booking, payment, vendor assignment, host approval, or guaranteed availability. Bellhopt reviews each request and follows up with next steps.
payload.longDescription:
Bellhopt 帮助度假租赁房客为入住期间申请礼宾服务。

房客可以浏览可用服务、选择所需项目、添加入住详情、输入房源地址，并提交请求供 Bellhopt 审核。根据地点和可用服务，请求可包括抵达前采购食品杂货、私人厨师体验、交通接送、SPA 与按摩、迎宾布置、庆祝活动布置，以及个性化入住需求。

Bellhopt 专为希望度假租赁体验更顺畅、准备更充分的旅客设计。它提供一个简单入口，让房客申请入住服务，无需四处寻找本地选项或手动协调一切。

提交请求并不代表确认预订、付款、供应商分配、房东批准或保证有空位。Bellhopt 会审核每项请求，并跟进后续步骤。

payload.name: tickadoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover theatre, musicals, tours, attractions and events across 700+ cities worldwide. Get real-time pricing and availability, see venue details, and book directly on tickadoo.com. Whether it's a night out in London, sightseeing in New York, or exploring Tokyo — just ask tickadoo ®. What Do You Wanna Doo? ®
payload.longDescription: 探索全球 700+ 个城市的戏剧、音乐剧、旅行团、景点和活动。获取实时价格和可用情况，查看场地详情，并直接在 tickadoo.com 预订。无论是在 London 度过夜晚、在 New York 观光，还是探索 Tokyo——只需询问 tickadoo ®。你想做什么？®

payload.name: Fridey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fridey brings your travel planning into ChatGPT. Connect your Fridey account and let AI help you organize every detail of your trips, from flights and hotels to daily activities and expenses.

What you can do:

📋 View your upcoming and past trips
✈️ Create new trips with destination, dates, and cover image
🏨 Add activities: flights, accommodation, restaurants, transport, and more
✏️ Edit or delete activities and trips
💸 Track expenses and get spending summaries by currency
🗺️ Search destinations for inspiration
Just say things like:
"Create a trip to Tokyo from June 10 to June 20"
"Add a hotel check-in at Park Hyatt on June 11"
"How much have I spent on my Japan trip?"
"Delete the dinner activity from my Bangkok trip"

Fridey is the travel planning app for people who love to explore. Available on iOS, Android, and web at fridey-travel.com
payload.longDescription:
Fridey 将旅行规划带入 ChatGPT。连接你的 Fridey 账户，让 AI 帮你安排旅程的每个细节，从航班和酒店到每日活动与开销。

你可以：

📋 查看即将开始和过去的行程
✈️ 创建行程，填写目的地、日期并添加封面图片
🏨 添加活动：航班、住宿、餐厅、交通等
✏️ 编辑或删除活动和行程
💸 记录开销，并按币种查看支出汇总
🗺️ 搜索目的地获取灵感
你可以这样提出请求：
“创建一次 6 月 10 日至 6 月 20 日的东京之旅”
“添加 6 月 11 日在柏悦酒店办理入住的安排”
“我在日本之旅中花了多少钱？”
“删除我曼谷行程中的晚餐活动”

Fridey 是为热爱探索的人打造的旅行规划应用，可在 iOS、Android 和网页端使用，网址为 fridey-travel.com

payload.name: Preferred Hotels & Resorts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leave the ordinary behind. From iconic city landmarks to secluded island sanctuaries, Preferred Hotels & Resorts invites you to discover a world of independent luxury hotels and resorts spanning the globe—each one distinct, each one unforgettable.

 

Tell us where you dream of going and what you long to feel, and we'll curate recommendations matched to your taste. Whether you're drawn to a pristine, white-sand beach, a design-forward urban retreat nestled in the heart of the city, or a grand resort set amidst nature's splendor, we'll help you envision exactly where your next extraordinary journey begins. Explore signature amenities, soak in the details that set each property apart, and discover your next stay in just a few messages.

 

As a member of the I Prefer Hotel Rewards loyalty program, you'll savor exclusive benefits, earn and redeem rewards, and enjoy personalized recognition at participating hotels worldwide. Whether you're planning a long-awaited escape or a last-minute journey, luxury travel begins here.
payload.longDescription:
告别平凡。从标志性的城市地标到僻静的海岛静居，Preferred Hotels & Resorts 邀你探索遍布全球的独立豪华酒店和度假村——每一家都独具特色，令人难忘。

告诉我们你梦想前往何处、期待怎样的感受，我们会根据你的喜好精选推荐。无论你向往洁白细腻的沙滩、坐落于城市中心且设计前卫的都市休憩之所，还是融于自然景致中的宏伟度假村，我们都会帮你想象下一段非凡旅程的起点。探索招牌设施，细品每家酒店的独特之处，只需几条消息即可发现下一次入住之选。

作为 I Prefer Hotel Rewards 忠诚计划会员，你可享受专属礼遇、赚取和兑换奖励，并在全球参与计划的酒店获得个性化礼遇。无论你计划已期待许久的度假，还是临时起意的旅程，奢华旅行都从这里开始。

payload.name: Yoteiko
payload.description: 借助 AI 更聪明地规划旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Yoteiko is an AI-powered travel planner for destinations worldwide. Search for attractions, restaurants, and hidden gems across any country, then get a personalized day-by-day itinerary built by AI. Whether you're planning a weekend in Paris, a two-week Japan rail trip, or a backpacking adventure through Southeast Asia, Yoteiko creates tailored plans with local recommendations, transit tips, and timing suggestions.
payload.longDescription: Yoteiko 是一款面向全球目的地的 AI 旅行规划工具。搜索任何国家的景点、餐厅和隐藏宝藏，然后获取由 AI 制定的个性化逐日行程。无论你计划在巴黎度过一个周末、进行为期两周的日本铁路旅行，还是背包游览东南亚，Yoteiko 都会根据需求制定计划，提供当地推荐、交通提示和时间安排建议。

payload.name: Total Parks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia?

Total Parks instantly connects you to the same systems the staff use at reception.

Total Parks can help you find holiday parks, caravan parks, and campgrounds by destination, features, room or site details, trip vibe, dates, guests, pets, and rig details, then check the real facts before you commit. 

Ask for parks near a place, options that look open for a travel window, powered or ensuite sites, accessible or spa cabins, whether a park welcomes dogs, if your caravan or motorhome will fit a site, or what a cabin actually includes - and get answers based on current Total Parks listing, capability, policy, and planning availability checks instead of guesswork. 

Every answer links back to totalparks.com.au, and when a stay looks like a good fit you'll get a booking link with your dates, guests, and pet or rig details already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
正在规划澳大利亚的房车、露营或小木屋之旅吗？

Total Parks 可即时连接到前台工作人员使用的同一套系统。

Total Parks 可按目的地、设施、客房或营位详情、旅行偏好、日期、宾客、宠物及车辆装备信息，帮助你查找假日公园、房车公园和露营地，并在预订前核实实际信息。

你可以询问某地附近的公园、某段行程日期内看起来有空位的选项、有电或带独立卫浴的营位、无障碍或带水疗设施的小屋、公园是否欢迎狗、你的房车或露营车能否停入营位，或小屋具体包含哪些设施。答复依据 Total Parks 当前的房源、设施能力、政策和规划可用性核查，而非猜测。

每条答复都会链接至 totalparks.com.au；当某处住宿看起来合适时，你会获得预订链接，其中已填写日期、宾客以及宠物或车辆信息。

payload.name: Porcel hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Porcel hotels Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Porcel hotels, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Porcel hotels?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.
payload.longDescription:
Porcel hotels Assistant 可通过聊天帮助住客查询酒店信息并完成常见预订操作。
用户可以询问 Porcel hotels 相关信息，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策以及入住和退房时间。助手还可以查询客房空余情况并列出可选的客房附加服务。
如果住客已有预订，助手可以在提供必要预订信息后检索预订详情，并协助修改或取消现有预订。
助手还可以帮助创建新预订；如果住客需要帮助，也可以向酒店发送支持请求。
您可以这样提问：
“Porcel hotels 的入住时间是几点？”
“下周末有空房吗？”
“显示可预订的房型。”
“修改我的预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”
“联系酒店，帮我处理预订问题。”

注意：部分预订操作可能需要您提供预订编号或住客信息等预订详情。

payload.name: FlatHunt
payload.description: 在柏林寻找带家具住房
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FlatHunt helps people find furnished apartments, studios, and private rooms in Berlin from multiple trusted housing providers.

Search by location, monthly budget, property type, number of rooms, size, move-in date, amenities, and other preferences. FlatHunt compares matching listings, presents the most relevant options in interactive cards, and links to the original provider page for current details and availability.

FlatHunt is designed for expats, professionals, students, couples, and anyone looking for furnished accommodation in Berlin.

Listings, prices, and availability may change. FlatHunt helps users discover and compare housing options but does not act as a landlord, property manager, or booking provider.
payload.longDescription:
FlatHunt 帮助用户从多个可信的住房供应商处寻找柏林的带家具公寓、单间和独立房间。

你可以按地点、月预算、房屋类型、房间数、面积、入住日期、设施和其他偏好搜索。FlatHunt 会比较匹配的房源，以交互式卡片展示最相关的选项，并链接到原始供应商页面，以查看最新详情和空房情况。

FlatHunt 适合外派人员、职场人士、学生、情侣以及任何在柏林寻找带家具住房的人。

房源、价格和空房情况可能会变化。FlatHunt 帮助用户发现和比较住房选项，但不充当房东、物业管理方或预订服务商。

payload.name: TravCozy
payload.summaryOriginal: All your trips in one place
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TravCozy keeps every part of your trip together. Ask ChatGPT about your travels and it answers from your real bookings — flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, and transfers imported from any booking site — organized into a day-by-day itinerary.

It also spots what's missing before you travel: nights without accommodation and arrivals with no onward transport. Add bookings right from the conversation by describing them, by uploading a confirmation file, or by forwarding booking emails to your TravCozy inbox — they're organized into the right trip automatically.

Requires a TravCozy account (travcozy.com).
payload.longDescription:
TravCozy 将旅行的各个环节集中在一起。向 ChatGPT 询问行程时，它会依据你的真实预订信息作答——包括从任意预订网站导入的航班、酒店、火车、租车和接送服务，并将它们整理成逐日行程。

它还会在出发前找出遗漏：没有住宿的夜晚，以及抵达后没有后续交通安排的情况。你可以直接在对话中添加预订：描述预订内容、上传确认文件，或将预订邮件转发至 TravCozy 收件箱；系统会自动把它们归入正确的行程。

需要 TravCozy 账户 (travcozy.com)。

payload.name: ride.auto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and book unique vehicles for rent, from everyday cars to Teslas, trucks, and SUVs. Search by location, dates, and vehicle type, compare pricing with full cost breakdowns, and book directly through the marketplace.
payload.longDescription: ride.auto 可查找并预订独特租赁车辆，从日常汽车到 Tesla、卡车和 SUV。按地点、日期和车型搜索，比较包含完整费用明细的价格，并直接通过市场平台预订。

payload.name: Sobo Beaches
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sobo Beaches helps you find and book beach huts for your holiday. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, your budget, and what matters most (location, view, dog friendly, accessibility). The app returns matching huts with key details and a link to complete your booking on sobobeaches.com.
payload.longDescription: Sobo Beaches 帮你为假期查找并预订海滩小屋。告诉 ChatGPT 你想去的地点和时间、预算，以及最看重的因素（位置、景观、是否允许携带狗、无障碍条件）。应用会返回符合条件的小屋及其关键信息，并提供在 sobobeaches.com 完成预订的链接。

payload.name: MeranO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the app of the city of Merano (South Tyrol, Italy) you always get up-to-date information on events,  hotels and accommodations, bike tours, hiking trails,  a gastronomy guide and much more. Discover Merano, its extensive parks and green promenades at any time of the year. The diverse cultural offerings range from the Merano Spring to the traditional "Traubenfest" and the Merano Christmas Markets, up to the Südtirol Festival Merano to the Merano WineFestival. Use your AI tool to plan your holiday at MeranO.
payload.longDescription: 使用意大利南蒂罗尔梅拉诺市的应用，你可以随时获得活动、酒店和住宿、自行车路线、徒步路线、美食指南等最新信息。一年四季探索梅拉诺及其广阔公园和绿色步道。丰富的文化活动包括 Merano Spring、传统的“Traubenfest”、梅拉诺圣诞市场、Südtirol Festival Merano 以及 Merano WineFestival。使用你的 AI 工具规划 MeranO 假期。

payload.name: Traffik Yacht Radar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Traffik measures the movement of the world's superyachts and private aviation from live public safety broadcasts. Ask for the weekly Traffik Index (100 = an ordinary week on the water), the measured pulse of any tracked yachting harbor — Monaco, Newport, Miami, Porto Cervo, the Hamptons and 150 more — plus private jets and helicopters into executive airports, or measured superyacht attendance at marquee events like the Monaco Grand Prix. Every number is a floor, not an estimate: only broadcasting vessels inside named geofences are counted, and every answer states its method and date.
payload.longDescription: Traffik 根据实时公开的安全广播，测量全球超级游艇和私人航空器的活动。你可以查询每周 Traffik 指数（100 = 普通水上活动周）、任一受追踪游艇港口的实测动态（包括 Monaco、Newport、Miami、Porto Cervo、Hamptons 等 150 多个地点）、飞往商务机场的私人飞机和直升机活动，或 Monaco Grand Prix 等大型活动中的超级游艇到场情况。每个数字都表示下限而非估算值：只统计位于指定地理围栏内且正在广播的船只，每条答复都会说明统计方法和日期。

payload.name: Kindred
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kindred is a global home-swapping community that turns every stay into a doorway to richer, more meaningful travel. Revolutionizing the way people travel by introducing a new model built on trust, connection, and member hosted homes — an alternative to both hotels and short-term rentals that makes travel more accessible, more conscientious, and more authentic.

Search by destination, dates, and guests to discover homes around the world. Explore thoughtfully curated spaces for a long weekend or extended adventure. Connect with local hosts who share their favorite neighborhood recommendations that help you travel more like a local.
payload.longDescription:
Kindred 是一个全球住房交换社区，让每次住宿都成为更丰富、更有意义旅行的入口。它以建立在信任、联系和会员提供的住房基础上的新模式革新旅行方式，提供酒店和短租住宿之外的选择，让旅行更易参与、更负责任且更真实。

按目的地、日期和宾客人数搜索，发现世界各地的住房。探索精心策划的住宿空间，安排长周末或长期冒险之旅。与当地房东联系，获取他们推荐的社区地点，像本地人一样旅行。

payload.name: The Houstonian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Houstonian app for ChatGPT makes it easy to learn about The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa in Houston, Texas. You can ask questions and quickly get helpful information about the hotel’s amenities, services, and general details—all within the conversation.

You can also check current room rates and availability without leaving ChatGPT. This makes it convenient for travelers, event planners, or anyone interested in the hotel to see up-to-date information while planning a visit.

By bringing this information directly into ChatGPT, the app provides a simple way to explore the hotel, learn what it offers, and review current pricing to help you decide if it’s the right place for your stay.

Note:
Responses are generated using artificial intelligence and may occasionally contain inaccuracies. The information provided is for general guidance only. Please avoid sharing sensitive personal information.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 版 The Houstonian 应用让你轻松了解位于德克萨斯州 Houston 的 The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa。你可以在对话中提问，快速获取有关酒店设施、服务和常规信息的帮助。

你还可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查看当前房价和空房情况。这对旅行者、活动策划者或任何希望在计划行程时了解最新信息的人来说都很方便。

通过将这些信息直接带入 ChatGPT，此应用提供了一种简单的方式，让你了解酒店及其服务，并查看当前价格，从而判断它是否适合你的住宿需求。

注意：
回复由人工智能生成，偶尔可能包含不准确之处。所提供的信息仅供一般参考。请避免分享敏感个人信息。

payload.name: DRAIV
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.

There is no rental counter, no key handover and no deposit blocked on your card. You unlock the car with your phone, so pickup works at any hour, including after a late flight. Cars stand at fixed locations across Zurich (City, Altstetten, Oerlikon) and at Zurich Airport, where you collect the car right at the terminal parking on rentals of two days or more.

Booking finishes on draiv.ch in your browser. No app to install.
payload.longDescription:
DRAIV 是位于瑞士苏黎世的无钥匙租车服务。告诉它你的需求——周末用的 SUV、今晚需要的电动车、供全家出行的七座车——DRAIV 就会显示实际可租的车辆、瑞士法郎的真实价格和直接预订链接。

无需租车柜台、无需交接钥匙，也不会冻结银行卡押金。用手机即可解锁车辆，因此任何时间都可以取车，包括深夜航班抵达后。车辆停放在苏黎世多个固定地点（City、Altstetten、Oerlikon）以及苏黎世机场；租期两天或以上时，可直接在航站楼停车场取车。

预订将在浏览器中通过 draiv.ch 完成。无需安装应用。

payload.name: pickthehotel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.

Choose an intent:
• iconic - the standout in town
• value - great, and fairly priced for what you get
• budget - cheap, clean, and genuinely central
• family - one room that actually sleeps two adults and the children

Every hotel is judged the same way - value (punching above its price), location (closeness to what you actually came for), and reviews (weighted by confidence, not just averaged) - with no paid placement. You can anchor "central" to a landmark ("near the Louvre") or to your live location, and you can ask for a curated list of long-established hotels around the world.

Live in Zürich, Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Bangkok, Dubai, Singapore, Istanbul, and Hong Kong, with more rolling out. Prices are indicative and confirmed at the booking site; booking links are affiliate and disclosed.
payload.longDescription:
pickthehotel 是酒店问答引擎。您无需面对一长串搜索结果，只需说明在某座城市想找什么样的酒店，即可获得一个明确推荐、几个备选项和预订链接。

选择偏好：
• 标志性——当地出众的酒店
• 高性价比——品质出色，价格与所得相称
• 经济型——便宜、干净且确实位于市中心
• 家庭型——一间能让两位成人和孩子实际入住的客房

每家酒店都按相同标准评估——性价比（品质是否超出其价格）、位置（是否靠近您实际要去的地方）和评论（按可信度加权，而非简单取平均）——没有付费排名。您可以将“市中心”定位到某个地标（例如“卢浮宫附近”）或您的实时位置，也可以索取全球历史悠久酒店的精选列表。

目前覆盖 Zürich、Paris、London、New York、Tokyo、Bangkok、Dubai、Singapore、Istanbul 和 Hong Kong，更多城市将陆续上线。价格仅供参考，最终价格以预订网站确认为准；预订链接含联盟营销标记并已披露。

payload.name: Airside Labs Aviation Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. Resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight identifiers with confidence, historical validity and source provenance. Inspect airport network integration, operator and ownership facts, engagement exceptions, connectivity and passenger-size bands. Explore a catalogue of aviation AI use cases, their data requirements, message lineage and an EASA framework screen. Reference and research data only: not live operational, flight-status, booking or safety-control information. Users can also submit product feedback for human review.
payload.longDescription: 面向分析师、研究人员和产品团队的航空参考工具。解析机场、航空公司、机型、注册编号和航班标识符，并提供置信度、历史有效性和来源信息。查看机场网络整合、运营方及所有权事实、参与例外情况、连通性和旅客规模区间。探索航空 AI 应用场景目录、其数据要求、消息来源链路，以及基于 EASA 框架的筛查。仅提供参考和研究数据，不提供实时运行、航班状态、预订或安全控制信息。用户也可以提交产品反馈，供人工审查。

payload.name: Ognissanti Hotels
payload.description: 查找佛罗伦萨酒店和游览
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and book rooms across the 7 Ognissanti Hotels in Florence: Palazzina Fusi, Hotel Lombardia, Hotel Arcadia, Hotel Villa Betania, L'Antica Porta, Residenza Ognissanti, and        
  Novella's Apartment.                                                                                                                                                                    
                                         
  Ask in plain language ("a quiet double near the Duomo for two nights in May") and the app returns live availability with real prices, photos, and a direct booking link from our        
  reservation system. You can generate a personalized quotation on the spot.           
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  You can also browse Florence experiences from our partner Ciao Florence — skip-the-line Uffizi tours, Tuscan wine tastings, Vespa rentals, cooking classes, day trips to Pisa and Siena 
  — each with a direct booking link.     
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  No login required. Booking and payment happen through our HotelInCloud reservation system, not inside the chat.
payload.longDescription:
搜索并预订佛罗伦萨 7 家 Ognissanti 酒店的客房：Palazzina Fusi、Hotel Lombardia、Hotel Arcadia、Hotel Villa Betania、L'Antica Porta、Residenza Ognissanti 和 Novella's

Apartment。
用自然语言询问（例如“五月住两晚，靠近大教堂的安静双人房”），应用会从我们的预订系统返回实时可用性、实际价格、照片和直接预订链接，也可即时生成个性化报价。
还可浏览合作伙伴

Ciao Florence 的佛罗伦萨体验，包括乌菲兹免排队游、托斯卡纳葡萄酒品鉴、Vespa 租赁、烹饪课以及前往比萨和锡耶纳的一日游，每项均带直接预订链接。

无需登录。预订和付款通过 HotelInCloud 预订系统完成，不在聊天内进行。

payload.name: RezervaOnline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RezervaOnline helps travelers find and book accommodation across Romania — guesthouses (pensiuni), hotels and villas. Search properties by locality or name, check real-time room availability and prices in Romanian lei (RON), and create a reservation directly in the conversation. Reservations are confirmed by the property and payment is made on arrival, so no online payment is required to book. RezervaOnline connects you to properties that manage their bookings on the RezervaOnline platform.
payload.longDescription: RezervaOnline 帮助旅客在罗马尼亚查找和预订住宿，包括民宿（pensiuni）、酒店和别墅。可按地点或名称搜索，查看实时房态及罗马尼亚列伊（RON）价格，并直接在对话中创建预订。预订由住宿方确认，抵达时付款，因此预订无需在线付款。该服务连接在 RezervaOnline 平台上管理预订的住宿方。

payload.name: HeyYumi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HeyYumi helps you find where to eat, drink, or go out in Korea — restaurants, cafes, bakeries, dessert shops, and bars — and book a table without leaving the chat. Every venue comes from Yumi's own refined, cross-verified dataset (346,000+ venues, strongest in Seoul, Gyeonggi, Busan and Jeju), each shipping with a confidence score and a last-checked date so answers stay grounded rather than guessed. Narrow results by 40+ food & drink attributes — neighborhood/station/landmark, cuisine, price, atmosphere, parking, pet-friendly, private room, vegan options, English-speaking staff, open-now, and more. At Yumi partner venues you can send a real reservation request to the owner right inside ChatGPT and get a confirmed/declined answer back.
payload.longDescription: HeyYumi 帮助你在韩国查找用餐、饮酒或休闲去处，包括餐厅、咖啡馆、面包店、甜品店和酒吧，并可在聊天中直接预订餐桌。所有地点均来自 Yumi 自有的精选交叉验证数据库（超过 346,000+ 家，首尔、京畿道、釜山和济州覆盖最丰富）；每条数据都附有置信度评分和最近核验日期，让回答有据可依，而不是凭空猜测。可按 40+ 种餐饮属性筛选结果，例如街区/车站/地标、菜系、价格、氛围、停车、是否允许宠物、包间、纯素选项、是否有英语服务人员、当前是否营业等。在 Yumi 合作场所，你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中向店主发送真实的预约请求，并收到确认或拒绝回复。

payload.name: Andeor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore current experiences across Mauritius with current marketplace facts from Andeor. Compare starting prices, duration, location and difficulty, and check published departures for your party. The public app is informational and does not provide external links or transactional actions.
payload.longDescription: 利用 Andeor 当前的市场信息，探索毛里求斯各地现有体验。比较起价、时长、地点和难度，并为你的同行团队查看已发布的出发安排。公开应用仅提供信息，不提供外部链接或交易操作。

payload.name: Powly
payload.description: 阿尔卑斯山滑雪场与雪况
payload.summaryOriginal: Ski resorts & snow in the Alps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 1,486 ski resorts in the Alps (AT, CH, DE, IT, FR, SI). Get snow forecasts, resort details, driving times from any city, powder-day alerts, side-by-side resort comparisons, and route maps. Data includes piste kilometers, lifts, elevation, glacier status, current snow depth, ski passes, and 16-day weather forecasts from Open-Meteo. Ask things like: "Which ski resorts are within 2 hours of Stuttgart?" - "Where is the most snow next week?" - "Soelden or Ischgl, which is bigger?" - "Show me the route to Zermatt".
payload.longDescription: 搜索阿尔卑斯山的 1,486 个滑雪场（AT、CH、DE、IT、FR、SI）。获取降雪预报、滑雪场详情、从任意城市出发的驾车时间、粉雪日提醒、滑雪场并排比较和路线地图。数据包括雪道公里数、缆车数量、海拔、冰川状况、当前雪深、滑雪通行证，以及来自 Open-Meteo 的 16 天天气预报。你可以这样问：“斯图加特 2 小时车程内有哪些滑雪场？”——“下周哪里雪最多？”——“Soelden 和 Ischgl 哪个更大？”——“显示前往 Zermatt 的路线”。

payload.name: Parra-Glideator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parra-Glideator helps pilots narrow down where and when conditions look most promising. Its read-only tools rank sites for selected dates, compare forecast-derived XC potential, show stored site overviews and historical seasonality, return launch and landing information, and surface curated local resources such as club pages, webcams, and meteostations. Results are decision support only: pilots must verify current conditions, local rules, airspace, access, and suitability for their skills and equipment before flying.
payload.longDescription: Parra-Glideator 帮助飞行员筛选条件看起来最理想的地点和时间。其只读工具可按选定日期对场地进行排名、比较基于预报得出的越野飞行潜力、展示已保存的场地概况和历史季节性信息、提供起飞与降落资料，并列出精选的本地资源，例如俱乐部页面、网络摄像头和气象站。结果仅用于辅助决策：飞行员起飞前必须自行核实当前条件、当地规则、空域、进入权限，以及其技能和装备是否适用。

payload.name: Vize Rehberim
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.
payload.longDescription:
为土耳其公民（普通/酒红色护照）提供签证申请信息和计算工具。

它可以回答“去日本需要签证吗？”“德国签证费用是多少？”以及“我的申根停留天数还剩多少？”等问题，并始终注明信息来源。

涵盖内容：

· 172 个国家的签证状态——55 个免签、23 个落地签、30 个电子签证、64 个需要向领事馆申请
· 各国的费用、公布的办理时间、申请中心和所需文件
· 根据欧盟委员会统计数据计算的土耳其申根签证申请拒签率（27 个国家）
· 拒签申诉：七个申根国家的主管机构、期限、语言和费用，以及标准表格中全部 17 种拒签理由的含义
· 计算器：申根 90/180 天停留额度、多次入境（级联）资格，以及按央行汇率计算的土耳其里拉总费用

数据收集方式：

每项金额和时长均经官方领事馆、政府部门或立法来源核实，并逐字引用。无法核实的数值不会发布——不作估算；相应字段会留空并明确说明为空。回答会注明来源和最后更新日期。

只有相关国家的领事馆可以签发签证。我们不是中介：不代办申请、不预约，也不保证获批。

payload.name: Travon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travon helps travelers view and understand their trip plans directly in ChatGPT.

You can use Travon to check your saved trips, review flights, hotels, activities, packing items, and other travel details, and ask questions about your itinerary in a natural way.

This ChatGPT app is read-only for now, so it helps you explore your existing travel information without changing your trip.
payload.longDescription:
Travon 帮助旅行者直接在 ChatGPT 中查看并了解旅行计划。

你可以使用 Travon 查看已保存的行程，检查航班、酒店、活动、行李物品和其他旅行详情，还可以用自然语言询问行程相关问题。

目前，这款 ChatGPT 应用为只读模式，因此可帮助你浏览现有旅行信息，但不会更改行程。

payload.name: Seaclub Alcudia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore SeaClub Alcudia, a family-friendly Mediterranean resort in Mallorca. Browse apartment types with photos, compare rooms side by side, and get direct booking.                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                         
Find everything you need for your stay: room layouts and capacity, amenities and on-site services, check-in and check-out times, contact details, and the resort's exact location on a map.                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                        Whether you're planning a family holiday or choosing between room types, compare apartments, view photos, or get practical details about the resort and the Alcudia area.
payload.longDescription:
探索 SeaClub Alcudia——位于马略卡岛、适合家庭入住的地中海度假村。浏览带照片的公寓类型，并排比较客房并直接预订。

查找住宿所需的所有信息：客房布局和容量、设施与现场服务、入住和退房时间、联系方式，以及度假村在地图上的准确位置。
无论你是在规划家庭假期，还是在不同客房类型间做选择，都可以比较公寓、查看照片，或了解度假村和 Alcudia 地区的实用信息。

payload.name: BookMyDestination.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search BookMyDestination.com for tour packages and activities, compare prices, view details and day-by-day itineraries, and check selectable travel dates. The current integration is read-only and does not create bookings or take payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 BookMyDestination.com 搜索旅游套餐和活动、比较价格、查看详情及每日行程，并检查可选旅行日期。当前集成为只读，不会创建预订或收取付款。

payload.name: HOTELS Trip & Travel Stays
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HOTELS finds a stay that fits your entire trip—not just a place to sleep.

It matches stays to your itinerary: close to your activities and restaurants, within your budget, and well located so you spend your trip exploring instead of commuting. Get personalized recommendations by location, price, amenities, and vibe—from budget boutiques to full-service chains.

Don't have an itinerary yet? HOTELS can help you plan your trip around where you stay. Get a short, ranked list of options that fit your needs, with the trade-offs clearly explained—so you can decide quickly and keep planning.
payload.longDescription:
HOTELS 帮你找到适合整趟旅程的住宿，而不只是一个过夜的地方。

它会根据你的行程匹配住宿：靠近活动地点和餐厅、符合预算，位置也方便，让你把时间花在探索而非通勤上。你可以按地点、价格、设施和风格获取个性化推荐，从经济型精品酒店到全服务连锁酒店均有选择。

还没有行程？HOTELS 也能帮你围绕住宿规划旅程。它会列出简短的推荐清单，并按匹配度排序，清楚说明各选项的取舍，方便你快速决定并继续规划。

payload.name: Leave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Leave account to find the right trip, summarize upcoming plans, check itinerary times and accommodation details, understand privacy-minimized budgets, expenses, and balances, find safe document metadata, review notes and tasks, and prepare approval-required trip changes. Leave remains the source of truth, and every request respects current trip membership, roles, scopes, and privacy rules.
payload.longDescription: 将 Leave 账户连接后，即可查找合适的旅行、总结即将到来的计划、查看行程时间和住宿详情、了解尽量减少隐私信息的预算、支出和余额、查找安全的文档元数据、查看备注和任务，并准备需要审批的行程变更。Leave 始终是权威数据源；每项请求都会遵守当前旅行成员身份、角色、权限范围和隐私规则。

payload.name: FREETOUR.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and book free walking tours, guided experiences, activities, day trips, and attraction tickets around the world with FREETOUR.com.

Explore more than 21000 tours, activities, and attractions across 2200 destinations in 150 countries.

Search by destination, date, language, price, rating, or tour type. Compare options, check availability, and explore tour details, schedules, meeting points, reviews, and pricing.

From tip-based free walking tours with local guides to food tours, cruises, nature experiences, day trips, and paid attractions, FREETOUR.com helps you find things to do that fit your trip, interests, and budget.
payload.longDescription:
通过 FREETOUR.com，探索并预订全球各地的免费徒步游、导览体验、活动、一日游和景点门票。

探索遍布 150 个国家、2200 个目的地的 21000 多项旅游线路、活动和景点。

可按目的地、日期、语言、价格、评分或旅游类型搜索。比较不同选项、查看空位，并了解行程详情、时间安排、集合地点、评价和价格。

从依靠小费的当地向导免费徒步游，到美食之旅、游船、自然体验、一日游和收费景点，FREETOUR.com 帮你根据行程、兴趣和预算找到合适的活动。

payload.name: AuroraReach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AuroraReach helps you plan when and where to see the northern lights using live aurora conditions, forecasts, viewing recommendations, historical activity and recent community sightings.

Ask about conditions in a specific city, compare nearby viewing locations, find the best time to go out, or plan an aurora evening. AuroraReach can also surface relevant tours and activities from GetYourGuide and Viator when available.
payload.longDescription:
AuroraReach 利用实时极光状况、预报、观赏建议、历史活动和社区近期目击记录，帮助你规划何时、何地观赏北极光。

询问特定城市的状况、比较附近的观赏地点、寻找最佳外出时间，或规划一个观赏极光的夜晚。AuroraReach 还可以在有相关信息时提供 GetYourGuide 和 Viator 的相关旅行团及活动。

payload.name: Concierge Radar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cotiza hospedaje con tarifas reales de Concierge Radar, compara opciones y crea borradores y ligas de propuestas para tus clientes desde ChatGPT. Requiere una cuenta registrada de Concierge Radar. No reserva, compra ni envía mensajes automáticamente.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 Concierge Radar 的真实住宿价格获取报价、比较选项，并为客户创建方案草稿和链接。需要注册 Concierge Radar 账户。不会自动预订、购买或发送消息。

payload.name: WAS Travel Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WAS Travel Insurance helps users compare Australian travel-insurance plans and prices for single trips or annual multi-trip cover, including optional cover preferences and purchase links.
payload.longDescription: WAS Travel Insurance 帮助用户比较澳大利亚旅行保险计划和价格，涵盖单次旅行或全年多次旅行保障，包括可选保障偏好和购买链接。

payload.name: AgentRoam
payload.description: 用加密货币购买旅行 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgentRoam helps travelers find and buy travel eSIM data plans with stablecoins and crypto. Choose your destination, compare available plans, pay from your wallet, and receive your eSIM setup details by email after checkout.

You can also explore crypto-friendly travel gift cards and airtime top-ups. AgentRoam is built for both travelers and AI agents, with MCP support for searching destinations, comparing plans, preparing checkout quotes, and tracking order status with user confirmation before purchase.
payload.longDescription:
AgentRoam 帮助旅行者使用稳定币和加密货币查找并购买旅行 eSIM 流量套餐。选择目的地，比较可用套餐，通过钱包支付，结账后通过电子邮件接收 eSIM 设置详情。

你还可以探索支持加密货币的旅行礼品卡和话费充值。AgentRoam 同时面向旅行者和 AI 智能体，提供 MCP 支持，用于搜索目的地、比较套餐、准备结账报价和跟踪订单状态，购买前需要用户确认。

payload.name: SeeyaTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Seeyatrip hotel catalog and cite hotels with booking links on the traveller's own dates.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Seeyatrip 酒店目录，并根据旅客自己的日期引用带有预订链接的酒店。

payload.name: Frip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unique local experiences in Korea with Frip. Find and book activities, one-day classes, social gatherings, and hobby experiences across Korea—all in one place.

Explore things to do by interest, location, and budget, from baking, crafts, wine, fitness, and outdoor adventures to dating events, local meetups, wellness, and travel activities.

Whether you’re planning a weekend in Seoul, looking for something special in Jeju or Busan, or searching for last-minute ideas nearby, Frip helps you discover memorable ways to spend your time.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Frip 探索韩国独特的本地体验。在韩国各地查找并预订活动、单日课程、社交聚会和兴趣体验，一站式完成。

按兴趣、地点和预算探索活动，内容包括烘焙、手工艺、葡萄酒、健身、户外探险、约会活动、本地聚会、健康体验和旅行活动。

无论你计划在首尔度过周末、想在济州岛或釜山寻找特别体验，还是临时想找附近的活动，Frip 都能帮你发现值得回味的消遣方式。

payload.name: Scioperi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check the calendar of scheduled strikes in Italy in real time, directly from your AI chat. The plugin connects to public strike data and lets you search strikes by sector (transport, schools, healthcare, etc.) and by region, with date-range filters.

Just ask "are there any transport strikes this week?" or "what strikes are planned in Lombardy next month?" to get an up-to-date, paginated, easy-to-browse list.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 AI 聊天中实时查看意大利计划中的罢工日历。该插件连接公共罢工数据，可按行业（交通、学校、医疗等）和地区搜索罢工，并按日期范围筛选。

只需询问“本周有交通罢工吗？”或“下个月伦巴第有哪些计划中的罢工？”，即可获得最新的分页列表，便于浏览。

payload.name: Sail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sail makes transportation choices simpler and more transparent. Find places and compare estimated prices, pickup times, and availability across ride-hailing services in 24+ countries. Where public transport coverage is available, Sail can also plan journeys with fares, walking directions, transfers, and boarding guidance. Compare available options for the same trip and choose what works best for you. Sail is read-only and does not book, track, or cancel rides. Results are estimates and may change before travel.
payload.longDescription: Sail 让交通选择更简单、更透明。在 24+ 个国家/地区查找地点，并比较网约车服务的预估价格、接驾时间和可用情况。在覆盖公共交通的地区，Sail 还可规划行程，提供票价、步行路线、换乘和乘车指引。比较同一行程的可用方案，选择最适合你的方式。Sail 为只读服务，不会预订、追踪或取消行程。结果为预估值，出行前可能会发生变化。

payload.name: Parks n Paws
payload.description: 查找可携狗入住的公园周边住宿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parks n Paws helps travelers find hand-reviewed dog-friendly hotels near US national parks. Each listing highlights practical pet-policy details such as fees, weight limits, breed restrictions, location, and dog-friendly amenities. We include honest pros and cons plus local tips like nearby vets, dog-friendly dining, and the best season to visit. The directory covers more than 1,300 hotels across 60 US national parks and 25 other iconic parks and monuments.
payload.longDescription: Parks n Paws 帮助旅客查找美国国家公园附近经过人工审核、允许携狗入住的酒店。每条房源都会突出实用的宠物政策信息，例如费用、体重限制、品种限制、地点和适合狗狗的设施。我们会提供客观的优缺点，以及附近兽医、可携狗用餐场所和最佳游览季节等本地建议。该目录涵盖 60 个美国国家公园和另外 25 个知名公园及纪念地周边的 1,300 多家酒店。

payload.name: How is my trip?
payload.description: 实时旅行中断风险监测
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: How is my trip? assesses travel disruption risk for a destination and date window, monitors trips for material changes, explains quiet periods, and provides current event and tourism context from published official-source data.
payload.longDescription: How is my trip? 会评估某个目的地在指定日期范围内的旅行受扰风险，监测旅程中的重大变化，解释平静期，并根据已发布的官方来源数据提供当前事件和旅游背景信息。

payload.name: MapQuest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get driving directions between any two addresses, with current traffic factored into your estimated arrival time. Search for restaurants, shops, services and other places near a location, and see how far away each one is. Look up the exact coordinates for an address, or find the nearest address for a set of coordinates. Running errands or making deliveries? Give MapQuest your list of stops and it will work out the most efficient order to visit them. Traffic incidents and construction along your route are flagged so you know what to expect before you leave.
payload.longDescription: 获取任意两个地址之间的驾车路线，预计到达时间会考虑当前交通状况。搜索某地点附近的餐馆、商店、服务和其他场所，并查看距离。查询地址的精确坐标，或根据一组坐标查找最近的地址。要跑腿或安排配送？把停靠点列表交给 MapQuest，它会计算最高效的访问顺序。路线上的交通事故和道路施工也会标记出来，让你出发前了解情况。

payload.name: tabiori
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tabiori helps travelers create and update shareable trip plans from ChatGPT conversations. After users connect their tabiori account with OAuth, the plugin can create a saved travel plan, add or update itineraries, schedules, checklists, notes, scraps, chat messages, images, hotel candidates, and sharing links. Changes are saved to the user's tabiori account so the plan can be opened and shared in tabiori.
payload.longDescription: tabiori 帮助旅行者根据 ChatGPT 对话创建和更新可分享的旅行计划。用户通过 OAuth 连接 tabiori 账户后，插件可以创建并保存旅行计划，添加或更新行程、日程、清单、笔记、素材片段、聊天消息、图片、酒店候选项和分享链接。更改会保存到用户的 tabiori 账户中，因此可以在 tabiori 中打开并分享计划。

payload.name: Aman
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the world of Aman. Plan your stay, explore destinations and learn about dining, wellness and cultural experiences crafted by Aman. Check available rooms and rates for preferred dates and review your selected stay before continuing to Aman’s booking site to reserve. Please note, reservations are not completed within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 探索 Aman 的世界。规划住宿、探索目的地，了解 Aman 精心打造的餐饮、康养和文化体验。查询心仪日期的空房和价格，查看所选住宿，然后前往 Aman 预订网站完成预订。请注意，预订不会在 ChatGPT 内完成。

payload.name: Musafir.com: Visa & Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.
payload.longDescription:
Musafir.com Visa 根据 Musafir.com 的实时产品目录回答签证问题：是否需要签证、费用、所需文件、处理时间，以及 Musafir.com 是否可以代办。若签证需要现场预约，还会显示已公布可用性的签证中心及其最近一次显示为开放的日期，让你在做决定前大致了解现实可行的时间。

签证规则、费用和处理时间不断变化，也因护照不同而异，因此记忆中的或公开发布的数字通常已不适用于提问者。这里的每个答案都来自为 Musafir.com 自有预订定价的目录，并注明适用市场。

你可以询问目的地、比较多个目的地，或确认所需材料及每份文件的提交方式（在线上传、带到签证中心或通过快递）。准备申请时，应用会把你的详细信息带到 Musafir.com 的匹配页面；申请提交后，Musafir.com

会为你预约。
Musafir.com 目前服务从阿联酋申请的旅行者。如果你居住地尚未覆盖，连接器会明确说明，而不会为你无法使用的流程报价。

此连接器为只读。它无法访问账户、查看或修改订单、锁定或预约，也不能收款。预约可用性是签证中心最近公布的信息，不是预订，也不是保证。它说明 Musafir.com 能办理的事项，这不等同于政府要求，也绝不预测签证是否获批。

payload.name: The Visa Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Visa Services answers your visa questions from the internal knowledge base: which countries and visa types are available, processing times, fees, required documents and application requirements. 
Ask in any language and get the answer in the same language. 
If the question needs more detail, the plugin asks which country or visa type you mean.
payload.longDescription:
The Visa Services 根据内部知识库回答签证问题，包括可办理的国家和签证类型、处理时间、费用、所需文件及申请要求。
你可以用任何语言提问，并以同一种语言获得答复。
如果问题需要更多信息，插件会询问你指的是哪个国家或签证类型。

payload.name: JPS — Award Search & Watch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JPS by BookLikeJoël lets connected members search live award-flight availability, review mileage-program results, and manage private JPS flight watches from ChatGPT. JPS does not book, hold, reserve, or issue tickets, and it never fabricates live inventory, mileage prices, taxes, seat counts, schedules, airlines, or booking links.
payload.longDescription: JPS by BookLikeJoël 让已连接的会员搜索实时奖励机票可用性、查看里程计划结果并管理私人航班关注。JPS 不会预订、保留、锁定或出票，也不会虚构实时库存、里程价格、税费、座位数、时刻、航空公司或预订链接。

payload.name: StayFritz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StayFritz helps travelers discover vacation rentals and hotels, check available stays, and continue to a secure booking flow. Search by destination, dates, number of guests, and travel preferences, then view property details, prices, amenities, and booking options. Final availability and payment are confirmed during checkout on StayFritz.
payload.longDescription: StayFritz 帮助旅行者发现度假租赁房和酒店、查看可入住选项，并继续进入安全预订流程。按目的地、日期、人数和旅行偏好搜索，然后查看房源详情、价格、设施和预订选项。最终的房态和付款将在 StayFritz 结账时确认。

payload.name: Roam Rule
payload.description: 查看税务与签证停留限制
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

The mobile app keeps your travel record up to date in the background, shows where you have been on a map and helps you stay ahead of tax residency, Schengen 90/180, visa and time-away limits, custom limits, alerts, tax signals and days needing review.

In ChatGPT, you can ask plain-English questions about your Roam Rule record before booking a trip, checking a Schengen stay, preparing for an adviser call or setting up a regular check-in. Ask about logged countries, current counters, upcoming thresholds and unresolved travel days, then get a quick visual summary of what needs attention next.

With Roam Rule in ChatGPT you can:

- check where your travel days are adding up before booking a trip
- ask what to review before another Schengen or visa-sensitive journey
- use a planned itinerary in the conversation to ask what counters you should check first
- prepare a quick summary before speaking to an accountant, adviser or immigration professional
- set a regular ChatGPT check-in to remind you to review your Roam Rule counters and days needing attention
payload.longDescription:
Roam Rule 是一款税务居民身份追踪和旅行天数限制应用，适用于外籍人士、创始人、顾问、机组人员及经常旅行者，帮助他们可靠记录各地停留天数的累计情况。

移动应用会在后台更新你的旅行记录，在地图上显示你去过的地方，并帮助你关注税务居民身份、申根 90/180 天规则、签证和离境时长限制、自定义限制、提醒、税务提示以及待审核天数。

在 ChatGPT 中，你可以在预订行程、核对申根停留、准备与顾问通话或设置定期检查前，用通俗语言询问 Roam Rule 记录。你可以询问已记录的国家、当前计数、即将达到的阈值和未解决的旅行天数，并快速获取可视化摘要，了解接下来需要关注什么。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Roam Rule，你可以：

- 在预订行程前查看旅行天数累计到了哪些地方
- 询问再次申根旅行或签证敏感行程前需要核查什么
- 在对话中提供计划行程，询问应先检查哪些计数
- 在联系会计师、顾问或移民专业人士前准备简要摘要
- 设置定期 ChatGPT 检查，提醒你查看 Roam Rule 计数及需要关注的天数

payload.name: Radisson Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?

When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
该插件发现并规划住宿。以下功能和限制适用：

Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?
When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.

payload.name: RegioJet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your companion for travel with RegioJet. Skip the complex search filters. Just type where you want to go, and it handles the rest: find the best routes and book your tickets instantly in one seamless conversation.
payload.longDescription: RegioJet 出行好帮手。无需使用复杂的搜索筛选器，只需输入目的地，其余交给它处理：通过一次流畅的对话查找最佳路线并即时预订车票。

payload.name: Zuzli
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zuzli helps travelers create, validate, view, and update day-by-day itineraries, including stops, routes, schedules, and live trip progress.
payload.longDescription: Zuzli 帮助旅行者创建、验证、查看和更新逐日行程，包括停靠点、路线、时间安排和实时行程进度。

payload.name: Sóley
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sóley is Iceland's tourism operator registry and live travel intelligence service. It searches Iceland's official licensed operator registers for accommodation providers, day tour operators and travel agencies across the country, with source attribution and freshness for every record. Registry listings are informational and are not automatically bookable. Only two clearly marked demonstration operators are currently bookable through Sóley. No real operator is currently bookable.

Sóley provides live Iceland conditions from authoritative sources, including weather, road conditions, safety alerts, earthquakes, aurora forecasts, avalanche conditions, air quality, flights, fuel prices, exchange rates, news and public transit. Curated multi-day itineraries, developed in collaboration with local tourism bodies in Iceland, connect routes to licensed operators near each stop.

Tourism operators are independent businesses that set their own terms and use their own payment providers. Each operator remains the merchant of record. Sóley is never the merchant of record, never receives traveler funds and never becomes a party to the traveler and operator purchase contract.
payload.longDescription:
Sóley 是冰岛旅游经营者登记查询和实时旅行信息服务。它会搜索冰岛官方许可经营者名录，查找全国各地的住宿提供者、一日游经营者和旅行社，并为每条记录注明来源和信息新鲜度。名录信息仅供参考，不能据此直接预订。目前只有两个明确标记为演示的经营者可以通过 Sóley 预订。当前没有任何真实经营者可供预订。

Sóley 提供来自权威来源的冰岛实时状况信息，包括天气、道路状况、安全警报、地震、极光预报、雪崩状况、空气质量、航班、燃油价格、汇率、新闻和公共交通。与冰岛当地旅游机构合作制定的精选多日行程，会将路线与每个停靠点附近的持牌经营者关联起来。

旅游经营者均为独立企业，自行制定条款并使用自己的支付服务商。每个经营者仍是记录在案的商家。Sóley 绝不会成为记录在案的商家，不会接收旅行者资金，也不会成为旅行者与经营者之间购买合同的一方。

payload.name: billiger-mietwagen.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare rental cars from leading providers in Germany directly from ChatGPT. Specify your destination, dates, and preferences to find the best deals. Compare prices across major rental companies, filter results by vehicle type, insurance options, and pick-up location, and get detailed offer breakdowns with pricing, terms, and conditions. Book through Billiger Mietwagen's website once you've found your rental car.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 查找和比较德国领先供应商的租车方案。说明目的地、日期和偏好，寻找最佳优惠。比较主要租车公司的价格，按车型、保险选项和取车地点筛选结果，并获取包含价格及条款条件的详细报价明细。找到合适的租赁车辆后，通过 Billiger Mietwagen 网站预订。

payload.name: VroomVroomVroom - Car Hire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: It's still VroomVroomVroom, just faster than ever — tell us where you're going and when, then we'll compare prices for you in one click.
payload.longDescription: 还是熟悉的 VroomVroomVroom，只是速度更快了——告诉我们你要去哪里、什么时候出发，我们就能一键为你比较价格。

payload.name: Houfy
payload.description: 直接寻找度假租赁房源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live Houfy vacation rentals by destination, dates, guests, price, property type, and amenities. Compare listing photos, pricing, ratings, and availability, inspect a selected property's public details, and continue to Houfy to book directly.
payload.longDescription: 按目的地、日期、人数、价格、房源类型和设施，实时搜索 Houfy 度假租赁房源。比较房源照片、价格、评分和空房情况，查看所选房源的公开详情，然后前往 Houfy 直接预订。

payload.name: ChooseCruise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChooseCruise helps users search live ocean and river cruise inventory by destination, ports, dates, cruise line, price, and duration, compare matching sailings, inspect detailed itineraries and cabin information, and continue to ChooseCruise when ready to book.
payload.longDescription: ChooseCruise 帮助用户按目的地、港口、日期、邮轮公司、价格和时长搜索实时海洋及河流邮轮库存，比较符合条件的航次，查看详细行程和舱房信息，并在准备预订时前往 ChooseCruise。

payload.name: FindCamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FindCamp gives neutral fit verdicts for European campsites, built from analysed public comments. Ask whether a specific campsite suits how you travel — family, light sleeper, beach, nature, quality, dog, or couple — and get a clear fit or no-fit, two or three reasons, and one honest tradeoff. It can also shortlist campsites for a profile or compare two side by side. FindCamp is a decision layer, not a booking site: it helps you decide, then points you to the campsite.
payload.longDescription: FindCamp 根据经过分析的公开评论，对欧洲露营地给出中立的匹配判断。你可以询问某个露营地是否符合你的旅行方式——例如适合家庭、浅眠者、海滩、自然、品质、带狗出游或情侣——并得到明确的适合或不适合结论、两到三个理由以及一项坦诚的取舍说明。它还可以根据个人需求生成露营地候选名单，或并排比较两个营地。FindCamp 是辅助决策的工具，不是预订网站：它帮助你做出选择，然后指引你前往露营地。

payload.name: Le Bon Road Trip Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Le Bon Road Trip Planner lets you find your saved trips and create or update itineraries, stops, notes, travel stories, places, photos, and budgets directly in ChatGPT. Every action is limited to the connected account, and trip-related results include a link to review changes in the Planner.
payload.longDescription: Le Bon Road Trip Planner 让你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查找已保存的旅程，并创建或更新行程、停靠点、备注、旅行故事、地点、照片和预算。所有操作都仅限于已连接的账户；与旅程相关的结果会附上链接，供你在 Planner 中查看更改。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yescapa is the world's leading campervan and motorhome rental marketplace, connecting travelers with thousands of vehicles from private owners and professionals across Europe, UK, USA, Canada and Australia.

Search directly in ChatGPT: tell it where and when you want to travel, how many people are coming, and it shows available campervans and motorhomes with real prices for your dates, traveller ratings and photos. Your booking is completed securely on the Yescapa website, with your dates already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Yescapa 是全球领先的露营车和房车租赁市场平台，为旅客对接欧洲、英国、美国、加拿大和澳大利亚的数千辆私人车主及专业运营商车辆。
